training_data.sources: Roboflow: 5 species datasets + boar + bird (wildlife), Forest scenery dataset (non_wildlife)

results.note: High val accuracy but poor generalization - misclassified 4/5 unfamiliar non_wildlife test images as wildlife. Likely dataset distribution mismatch between wildlife and non_wildlife sources.

known_issues: non_wildlife images sourced primarily from one stylistically distinct 'forest scenery' dataset, likely causing the model to learn dataset style rather than general animal presence
next_steps: Diversify non_wildlife sourcing, retrain as v2
